messages:
nina.ops: Heads up — noticed a failed canary job this morning where ops-gate rejected the rollout trigger. Saw a bunch of `permission denied: role not found` from gatekeeper.
sanjay.sec: :eyes: any chance it's related to the RBAC refactor last week? which role is missing?
lee.sre: Logs show `role:team:ops:canary-executor` lookup returned 404 from role-service cache. Role exists in DB though. Suspect cache staleness after migration.
maria.pm: The canary should be gated by `canary-executor` role, correct? This blocked a canary stage for an A/B rollout and auto-fallback didn't run.
nina.ops: Correct. Sequence:
1) canary trigger -> gatekeeper checks RBAC cache
2) cache misses -> tries role-service -> transient 502s -> denies
log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T07:12:11Z gatekeeper ERROR deny uid=... reason="role lookup failed: 502"
2026-03-18T07:12:11Z gatekeeper DEBUG role-cache.lookup key=team:ops:canary-executor ttl=0
```
lee.sre: I reproduced locally by killing the role-service pod; gatekeeper default behaviour is to deny if it can't validate. We should fail open for canary triggers? Not ideal.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: Canary rollout 2026-03-18T07:00 failed stage=gatecheck status=DENIED
sanjay.sec: Failing closed is safer but we must ensure audit events are emitted so ops can triage. Are audit logs present for the denied attempts?
audit-bot: Missing audit events detected for 07:12:10-07:12:20 window. Some events buffered in async batch queue; last flush at 07:00. :lock:
nina.ops: That's the worrying bit — both the deny and the lack of audit entries. If the audit pipeline is buffering for minutes on restarts that violates our compliance SLO.
maria.pm: Could KMS rotation have touched the audit pipeline? I saw a KMS rotation last night for the audit-encrypt key.
lee.sre: KMS rotation log shows a brief key ring swap at 02:15, but audit producer should handle key rotation. Checking producer logs now.
lee.sre: producer stderr shows: `Error: decrypt failed: key not found` around 07:10 when we were redeploying role-service earlier. That explains the buffer not flushing.
sanjay.sec: So sequence could be: role-service migration + transient 502s -> gatekeeper denies -> audit-producer fails to encrypt events due to KMS rotate staleness -> events buffered and not flushed -> missing audit records. Bad combo.
nina.ops: Agreed. Short-term mitigation ideas:
- hotfix: gatekeeper allowlist for internal canary service account (fail-open for autopilot rollouts)
- immediately flush audit queue (force rotate creds for audit-producer)
- role-service cache TTL set to 30s -> change to 0/real-time or implement warm-cache on migration
maria.pm: Which one can we push safely right now? I prefer not to fail-open globally.
lee.sre: I can push a scoped allowlist on gatekeeper to allow `service:ci:canary-runner` only for canary triggers. Small change, no role model changes.
sanjay.sec: Also we need a patch for audit-producer to retry KMS decrypt with fallback to new key IDs; I'll open a ticket to escalate with infra on KMS rotation handling.
nina.ops: Action items:
- lee.sre: push scoped allowlist to gatekeeper in staging and run canary (ETA 30m)
- lee.sre: force flush audit queue or restart producer with fresh KMS creds (ETA 15m)
- sanjay.sec: create postmortem draft with timeline and vuln triage (ETA 2h)
- maria.pm: notify affected customers and pause any further rollouts that would touch canary gate (ETA 10m)
maria.pm: I'll also ask support to surface any incidents that correlate.
lee.sre: doing the restart now.
deploy-bot: deploy: gatekeeper patch posted to staging at 07:45 (pr/5927)
nina.ops: Thanks. Keep this thread updated with timestamps and evidence for the postmortem. Also add any audit IDs once the flush completes.
sanjay.sec: Noted. I'll attach logs and KMS key rotation records when done.
audit-bot: Audit flush completed at 07:21:12, 42 events written to S3 (some events previously missing now ingested). :white_check_mark:
lee.sre: Staging canary passed after scoped allowlist. Rolling the change to prod with manual approval.
maria.pm: Approved to roll to prod, but gatekeeper change scope and audit flush steps must be in the PM notes.
nina.ops: Final: will we do a config change to increase role-service cache refresh on migration? If yes, schedule and test.
sanjay.sec: Yes — we should set cache warm-on-migration and increase default TTL to 5s for critical roles. I'll add to the infra ticket.
maria.pm: Thanks everyone. Postmortem draft link: https://redwood.internal/pm/incidents/2026-03-18-canary-gatekeeper (will fill in details)
nina.ops: closing loop once postmortem posted. :thumbsup:
